tools.name: farel_find_platform_module
tools.description: Search Farel's airline platform modules (reservations, inventory, departure control, distribution, revenue management, payments, finance, weight and balance, AI copilot) and return the best matches with their URLs. Use this when the user asks what Farel does or asks about a specific airline system capability.

query.description: What the user is looking for, e.g. 'check-in', 'revenue management', 'booking engine'.

tools.name: farel_get_pricing_model
tools.description: Explain how Farel charges: one fee per boarded passenger with every module included, annual contracts, and no change orders. Returns what is and is not covered. Note the published rate is intentionally not disclosed — route to farel_request_demo for an actual quote.

tools.name: farel_list_pages
tools.description: List published farel.io pages with titles, descriptions and URLs, optionally filtered to one section. Use this to navigate the site or to find a page not covered by the other tools.

category.description: Optional section filter. Omit to list every page.

tools.name: farel_request_demo
tools.description: Return the URL and guidance for requesting a Farel demo. Use when the user is ready to talk to the team or wants a real price. Returns instructions only — the agent must not submit the form on the user's behalf.
